summary: Iteration 40 - SIP.js Integration Testing Complete. All features verified: (1) GET /api/calling/pbx-configs/sip-credentials endpoint returns SIP credentials for registration, (2) PBX update preserves passwords when blank values submitted, (3) PBX settings page shows SIP status badge (Connecting/Registered/Error), (4) SIP error details card displays when registration fails, (5) WebSocket URL field has prominent label and helper text, (6) Auto-derive WebSocket URL from host when not set, (7) Dialer shows SIP/WebRTC/SIP Err status badge, (8) All 5 PBX tabs work (Extensions, PBX, Queues, Auto-Attendant, Rules).
